يستهلك (form X)
# يَسْتَهْلِكُ (yastahliku) /jas.tah.li.ku/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# يُسْتَهْلَكُ (yustahlaku) /jus.tah.la.ku/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَهْلَكَ (istahlaka)
# يَسْتَهْلِكَ (yastahlika) /jas.tah.li.ka/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَهْلَك
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
